claim_type: rigorous low-intensity L2 concentration and disproof of a uniform positive variance lower bound
limitations: The low-intensity theorem and bound \(0<V\le 1\) are rigorous.
Finite-intensity numerical values are illustrations only; the supplied quadrature is not an interval certificate.
The result does not determine the finer scale of the variance, including the open \(\lambda\operatorname{Var}(A_\lambda)\) question.
provenance: Previously published finding; independently reassessed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
